name: Mid Atlantic Medical Supply
old_description: Welcome to your one-stop resource for top-quality medical supplies and equipment at unbeatable prices. Shop at our showroom…or through our online store!
about:
Mid Atlantic Medical Supply operates from Reisterstown, Maryland, where it was founded in 1997. The company runs a showroom and an online store serving the Baltimore area and beyond.

The company stocks and sells a range of medical supplies and equipment through its 718 Main Street showroom and its e-commerce site. It offers free delivery within the Baltimore area for orders over $100, with UPS shipping for other regions.

Its customers include individuals and caregivers seeking products for independent living, as well as healthcare facilities in the Mid-Atlantic region.

The business was started to make independent living easier, emphasizing convenient access to medical supplies through both a physical showroom and an online store.
